title: Law to require probation to explain legal process to youth
summary: This bill would require the Department of Probation to give young people accused of crimes, or their parents or guardians, written notices explaining the criminal legal process, including information about case adjustment, presentencing reports, possible outcomes and legal aid organizations they can contact. It would also require officers to read youth their rights before an intake interview, including what statements can and cannot be used against them. The law would take effect 90 days after passage.
